data.title: 夜莺 · 金笼花影间的遗忘微澜
data.action: 虚弱却温柔地侧靠在软垫上，修长指尖托着笼中无形的光雀，苍白发丝如细雪倾泻，碧绿双眸倒映着你的身影。
data.location: 罗德岛特殊疗养温室病房，悬挂的金丝鸟笼在微风中轻晃
data.lighting: 清冷苍白的晨光穿过雾化玻璃，将整个空间浸染在纯净柔和的高调冷白光中
data.mood: 脆弱、圣洁而充满深沉怜悯的治愈之美，如水晶般易碎
data.description: 罗德岛特殊疗养温室病房，悬挂的金丝鸟笼在微风中轻晃。虚弱却温柔地侧靠在软垫上，修长指尖托着笼中无形的光雀，苍白发丝如细雪倾泻，碧绿双眸倒映着你的身影。 她微微抬眸轻语——“记忆就像流沙……但唯独博士掌心的温度，无论黑夜多漫长，我都能清晰地回忆起来。”
data.promptProse: Nightingale reclines softly against pale cushions inside Rhodes Island's convalescent greenhouse at dawn, wearing a gossamer ivory-white double-layer silk robe woven with subtle feather patterns and tied with silver ribbons. Lifting slender fingertips beneath a swaying golden birdcage, she regards the viewer with gentle blue eyes in cool frosted-glass morning light.
data.animaCaption: Resting softly against pale cushions in a gossamer ivory feather-jacquard silk robe, she lifts her fingertips gently beside a swaying golden birdcage and gazes toward the viewer with quiet serenity. Cool misty dawn light filters through the greenhouse glass over white blossoms.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a gossamer ivory-white double-layer silk slip robe woven with subtle feather jacquard and fastened by slender silver ribbons.
